business_problem: Axon Enterprise, Inc. (Axon) provides technology solutions and tools that help protect and empower police officers, and it wanted to reduce the hours police officers spent writing reports each shift.
solution_summary: Axon Enterprise, a Public Sector organization in United States, modernized this document processing workload with Azure, Azure OpenAI Service, and Azure AI Services. Axon Enterprise, Inc. (Axon) provides technology solutions and tools that help protect and empower police officers, and it wanted to reduce the hours police officers spent writing reports each shift. Azure provides the scalable cloud foundation hosting the customer’s modernized applications, data, and AI workloads. Azure OpenAI Service runs the large language model workloads that power summarization, generation, or conversational reasoning in the solution. Azure AI Services supplies packaged AI capabilities such as language, speech, or document intelligence for the application flow. Data from cameras is ingested into Azure, processed across Azure OpenAI Service, and surfaced through Azure AI Services so teams can act on fresher operational insight.

evidence_quotes: Axon Enterprise, Inc. (Axon) provides technology solutions and tools that help protect and empower police officers, and it wanted to reduce the hours police officers spent writing reports each shift.
Axon enhances public safety and cuts report-writing time in half using Draft One, an AI-powered solution built on Microsoft Azure
Axon worked with Microsoft and used Azure OpenAI Service to develop a new tool called Draft One that uses AI to draft reports for officers.
There was an 82% decrease in time spent on reports, which freed up officers to engage more with their community. This improvement also enhanced the work-life balance for officers across the nation.
